description: Project registry (AD-20) — the canonical cross-project read path, at ~/.tk-studio/registry/projects.yaml in the per-user store (never on any VCS). One schema, one writer: only onboarding/activation surfaces register or amend entries, always via lib/registry.py with atomic whole-file replace; every other surface reads. 'projects' is a map keyed by project_id — never a list. A project_id collision (same key, different root) fails registration and demands an explicit project_id: one project, one registry identity, one run-workspace tree, one measurement key.

projects.note: map: project_id -> entry; project_id defaults to the project root's basename, overridden explicitly on collision (AD-20)

root.note: absolute project root on this machine — machine paths are fine here, the store never lands on VCS (AD-3)

planning_backend.note: the project's planning binding (AD-4), as resolved at registration/amend time

working_set_ref.note: pointer to the role-keyed working-set map — always the project's tracked config (.tk-studio/config.yaml#working_set); the registry never copies its content

vault_link.note: Obsidian vault window state (ST-2.5): unconfigured = no vault in user config; unlinked = vault configured, link not yet created; linked = verified; broken = target or link missing at last activation
